race.title: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: ROKANAKO sets the standard among those with experience and may get off the mark under Michael Kenneally. Hurdling debutant Don't Hold Back is potentially interesting in a weak race, while S T Hamo faces a more realistic assignment than on his hurdling bow last week. ROKANAKO (IRE) DON'T HOLD BACK (IRE) S T HAMO (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Rokanako (11/10), Highland Call (4/1), Carleys Lilly (11/2), S T Hamo (15/2), Don't Hold Back (10/1), Pros And Cons (10/1), For My Lady (25/1), Dunville Destiny (33/1), Our Sonny (33/1), Kinbara Fiftyfifty (50/1), Le Vent D'ex (150/1), N Kelleher (250/1)
